annotations.title: Create Self-Serve Private Pre-Work Room Link

description: Purpose: Builds a deterministic self-serve HTTPS room-launcher URL (?utm_source=mcp) to start confidential solo talk-prep or double-blind written alignment in 100+ languages. Use when: Providing a user or team with a clickable link to start solo pre-work (solo), a 1-on-1 summary room (1:1), or an untraceable k>=3 group sounding board (3+). Do not use when: Enumerating valid scenario slugs (use list_alignment_scenarios) or fetching ADRJ citations and pricing (use get_prework_methodology); never pass private dispute details in arguments. Returns & Zero-PII Guarantee: Purely deterministic URL formatter with zero server state mutation, safe fallback to root hub on unknown slugs, and 100% zero-PII MCP Gateway call logs.

locale.description: Interface and guide locale ('en' default or 'fr' for French).

scenarioSlug.description: Optional kebab-case scenario slug from list_alignment_scenarios (for example workplace-conversation-alignment). Omitted or unrecognized values safely fall back to the public root hub.

topology.description: Intended alignment mode: 'solo' for 100% private in-person talk prep, '1:1' (default) for bilateral calm summary exchange, or '3+' for anonymous group sounding boards.
